query: Economist YouGov poll registered voters generic ballot margin

results.content:
Among registered voters, Democrats led the generic congressional ballot 42 percent to 37 percent. Independents favored Democratic candidates by 12 points.

Reuters/Ipsos surveyed 4,505 U.S. adults nationwide online July 30-August 3. The poll had a margin of error of 2 percentage points.

## Competitive Districts Show Similar Pattern

New analysis from Economist/YouGov suggested Democratic strength extends beyond heavily blue districts.
results.title: Donald Trump Gets Worrying Midterm Warning Sign Across 3 New Polls

results.content: Methodology: The Economist/YouGov poll was conducted online between July 17 and July 20, 2026, among a weighted sample of 1,689 U.S. adult citizens drawn from YouGov's opt-in panel. The data were weighted to reflect the U.S. adult population by demographics, voter registration, party identification and past voting behavior. The poll has a margin of error of plus or minus 3.3 percentage points for adults and plus or minus 3.2 percentage points among registered voters. results.title: Donald Trump’s Approval Rating With Men Crashes to Record Low

results.content:
The latest Fox News poll, conducted July 17-20 among 1,003 registered voters nationwide, reported a margin of error of plus or minus 3 percentage points.

The latest Economist/YouGov survey was conducted July 17-20 among 1,602 U.S. adult citizens with a margin of error of plus or minus 3.3 percentage points after weighting.

Echelon Insights' July omnibus survey was conducted July 9-13 among 1,004 likely voters and carried a margin of error of plus or minus 3.6 percentage points.
